title: The Old Light F4 - The Backwards Inn
_note: Old Light floor 4 (pearlmoor_oldlight_4). The theme back-to-front and upside-down. Bars 1-8: registers SWAPPED - the tune walks in the tri_bass an octave down while the oom-pah climbs up top as a flipped "pah-oom" (high roots on the off-beat), and the laughs run UP with an inhaled "ffp". Bars 9-16: the B section straight, so the ear keeps the tune. Bars 17-32: bars 1-16 played in RETROGRADE, every track mirrored note for note (the bass lands on the off-beats, laughs rise, rimshots go tss-dum-ba, glides reverse); it ends on the reversed first bar of B (Bb) which falls plagally into bar 1's F. 120 BPM, 4/4, F major, 32 bars.
